title: Cosmobox Level2 campaign manifest (v1)
description: Machine-readable transcription of the Level2 first-test scientific contract (docs/levels/level2/spectral-regime-design.md, docs/levels/level2/profile-comparison-preregistration.md, docs/levels/level2/numerical-guard-protocol.md). Fixes exactly the six frozen (geometry, spin) cases, the reference-Hamiltonian/full-spectrum requirement, the primary/control metric split, and the inter-S comparison policy -- no scientific degree of freedom beyond what is already frozen. n_flavors, J, h, t, g_E, K, and external_charges are deliberately absent: they are never manifest-level parameters, they are derived exclusively by cosmobox.level2.execution's own frozen constants (REFERENCE_N_FLAVORS, build_reference_hamiltonian_parameters, REFERENCE_EXTERNAL_CHARGES).

frozen_preregistration_commit.description: The exact commit that froze docs/levels/level2/profile-comparison-preregistration.md (L2_C_PREREGISTRATION = FROZEN).

numerical_guard_reference.description: The frozen L2-C1 numerical zero-resolution guards. Reproducibility guards only -- never a physical effect threshold, never widened post-hoc.

cases.description: Exactly the six frozen Level2 cases, in deterministic (geometry-major, spin-minor) order -- the same order as cosmobox.level2.execution.build_all_reference_case_specs().

inter_s_policy.description: Per the L2-D3 control-metric arbitration: primary metrics get a taxonomy and both shape descriptors; control metrics stay descriptive only (no taxonomy, no C_X_23/D_X_23, no L2-C1 guard classification).
